mainEntity.name: What kind of warranty or guarantee do you offer on your painting services?

acceptedAnswer.text: We stand behind the quality of our workmanship and the durability of the materials we use. Modern Builders offers a comprehensive warranty on our exterior house painting services. This warranty typically covers issues related to paint adhesion, peeling, and blistering due to faulty application for a specified period. Details of the warranty, including duration and coverage, are provided in your project contract to ensure full transparency and peace of mind.
